input.title: Single selected thought should follow cursor
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
- b
- c
```

1. Long tap `a` to select.
2. Short tap `b`.

## Current Behavior

`a` stays selected and the cursor moves to `b`.

## Expected Behavior

In the above case, `a` should be deselected and `b` should be selected.

More generally, the currently selected thought should always be deselected and the new cursor selected on tap when the command center is open and a single thought is selected.

## Testing

Add tests to https://github.com/cybersemics/em/blob/a8a012eb998353cd7b4187ddafaba4a8f5823690/src/e2e/puppeteer/__tests__/multiselect.ts. Tests should cover the selected thoughts and the cursor.
